services_page.title: Our Services

what_we_offer.title: What We Offer
what_we_offer.description: NASSU provides a wide range of services designed to support Orthodox Christian education in parishes across North America.

services.title: Sunday School Curriculum
services.description: Comprehensive and age-appropriate curriculum materials for Sunday Schools.

services.title: Teacher Training
services.description: Training programs and resources for Sunday School teachers.

services.title: Youth Events
services.description: Organizing and supporting youth events and activities.

services.title: Resource Development
services.description: Creating and distributing educational resources for Orthodox education.

services.title: Webinars and Online Classes
services.description: Online learning opportunities for students and teachers.

services.title: Parent Support
services.description: Resources and guidance for parents to support their children's spiritual education.

services.title: Audio Resources
services.description: Audio materials for learning and spiritual growth.

services.title: Parish Consultation
services.description: Guidance and support for parish education programs.

services_page.how_we_help: How We Can Help Your Parish

process_steps.title: Initial Consultation
process_steps.description: We discuss your parish's specific needs and challenges.

process_steps.title: Customized Plan
process_steps.description: We create a tailored plan to address your educational needs.

process_steps.title: Implementation
process_steps.description: We help implement the plan with your team.

process_steps.title: Ongoing Support
process_steps.description: We provide continuous support and resources.
